categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Sino-Microelectronics Tech Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, testing, sales, and services of special integrated circuits. Its product portfolio includes digital integrated circuits such as programmable logic devices (FPGA, CPLD, SoPC, RF-FPGA), microcontrollers (MCU/SoC/SIP), storage chips (NORFlash, EEPROM), and analog integrated circuits including high-speed/high-precision ADC/DAC converters, power management chips, and bus interface chips. The company also provides ASIC/SoC system-level chip solutions and integrated circuit testing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced semiconductor design technologies including 28nm CMOS process for high-performance FPGA and RF-FPGA chips, and various CMOS processes for ADC/DAC and MCU products. It uses a fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging to specialized foundries while focusing on in-house chip design and testing. Core technologies include proprietary FPGA architecture, high-speed low-power FPGA design, integrated CPU-FPGA SoC, embedded FPGA (eFPGA), high-precision ADC/DAC design, and advanced packaging techniques such as vertical stacking for memory chips. The company also has a national-level integrated circuit testing center certified by CNAS.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers are mainly large state-owned enterprises and central government groups in China, including China Electronics Technology Group Corporation, Aviation Industry Corporation of China, China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, and China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation. Its products serve specialized sectors such as electronics, communications, control systems, measurement, satellite communications, radar detection, electronic countermeasures, industrial control, energy exploration, and high-end instrumentation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with its headquarters and main operations located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, including the Sichuan Free Trade Zone and Chengdu High-tech Zone. Its sales and services cover domestic markets extensively, focusing on Chinese special integrated circuit industry customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu Sino-Microelectronics operates as a fabless semiconductor design company, focusing on chip design, development, testing, and sales. It outsources wafer fabrication and packaging to external foundries and packaging service providers, positioning itself upstream in the semiconductor supply chain with strong in-house testing capabilities to ensure product reliability for specialized applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment, dedicating over 25% of revenue to research and development, focusing on high-performance FPGA, high-speed/high-precision ADC/DAC, intelligent heterogeneous SoC chips, and MCU products. It aims to build a unified digital-analog mixed-signal high-end integrated circuit design platform and enhance domestic localization of special integrated circuits. The company also invests in expanding its testing and reliability assurance capabilities and collaborates with top universities for talent cultivation and technology innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of integrated circuit products and related technical services. The company employs a direct sales model with a comprehensive domestic sales network covering major customers in the special integrated circuit market. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns related to its R&D activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chengdu Sino-Microelectronics is positioned as a leading domestic player in the special integrated circuit design industry in China, particularly in programmable logic devices (CPLD/FPGA) and high-precision ADC sectors. It is one of the few companies undertaking both digital and analog integrated circuit national key projects. The company competes with international semiconductor firms but focuses on specialized, high-reliability applications with strong government and industry backing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 603.9 million, a 34.79% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 122.17 million, down 60.73%. Total assets reached RMB 3.67 billion, up 61.36%, and net assets attributable to shareholders increased 114% to RMB 2.81 billion, mainly due to a successful IPO raising RMB 1.415 billion. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of 25.46% of revenue, reflecting a focus on innovation despite revenue fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its deep technical expertise and comprehensive R&D capabilities in special integrated circuits, offering a broad product portfolio with domestic leading performance in FPGA, high-speed/high-precision ADC, and MCU products. It provides integrated circuit comprehensive solutions tailored for high-reliability, high-performance applications in specialized fields. Its in-house national-level testing center and strict quality management system ensure product reliability and customer trust, differentiating it in the specialized semiconductor market.
